pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The patches exhibit a multi-lobed, stellate geometry with highly irregular margins. Pixel gradients at the edges are moderately soft, transitioning from light-tan to a creamy background. Individual dark regions are non-geometric, characterized by jagged projections and inconsistent spatial areas across the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space light pelage forms a wide, continuous lattice. Junction nodes typically manifest as broad, irregular intersections. The pixel thickness of these corridors is substantial, often representing 30-50% of the width of adjacent patches, maintaining high topological connectivity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck presents a finely serrated 1D silhouette. It consists of high-frequency, low-amplitude bristly hair clusters that create a jagged contour against the out-of-focus background.
